$comment: Golden conversation for the HelloCamera phone-client conformance kit. Meta-format: docs/conformance/README.md. Each step is one WebSocket frame; 'message' is a closed wire object validated against the named schema.
title: Valid v2 negotiation with the visual-guidance bundle
summary: Phone sends the exact closed v1 hello, then protocol_v2_offer as the first text message after hello, then the desktop accepts before processing observations. Accepted capabilities are a subset of the offered set, include the mandatory camera_agent_interaction_v2 bundle, and accept generated_visual_guidance_v2 only because the v1 hello advertised both high_resolution_request and sample_image.

steps.note: Exact closed v1 hello. No v2 capability strings, no version: 2. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §4.1)
First text message after hello and before observations. camera_agent_interaction_v2 is mandatory in every offer. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §4.1)
Accepted subset includes the mandatory bundle and the visual bundle; visual acceptance is valid because hello advertised high_resolution_request and sample_image. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §4.2)

outcome: Wire mode atomically switches to v2 interaction output. The desktop suppresses v1 results; the phone ignores any late v1 results. sessionId is established as a memory-only continuity handle. Retained phone display is read-only during negotiation.
